notes.purpose: Combo-specific articles for Paranoid Times newspaper when multiple cards synergize in a single turn.
notes.integration: Match by card IDs or by tags. Highest priority match wins. Exclusive combos suppress lower-priority ones.
notes.how_to_use: Load after per-card article bank. For each turn, build a turn signature from played cards (IDs, factions, tags). Evaluate combos by priority, emit up to N articles.

combos.subhead: Witnesses report firm handshake, questionable grooming tips.

Sources close to the saplings claim the agenda included forest corridor treaties, photo consent, and joint statements on blurry imagery.

combos.imagePrompt: {style}, forest press scrum, Bigfoot and Bat Boy at makeshift podium, disposable camera flash, deadpan crowd
